pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Cool-season:$() sow as soon as the ground thaws. Sprouts after 110 °C·d above 4 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1000 °C·d$(). Best near 20 °C; stops above 32 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -3 °C (-2 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 6-7.5 (tolerates 5.5-8). Roots 0.6 m. Some tolerance of wet soil.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 110, P 18, K 160 kg/ha per crop.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 268 cwt/ac (30 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Beetroot and Beetroot Seeds.
